note: Requirements the hosting proxy must meet and that scripts/hosted-smoke.ts checks against the real origin. Application-enforced limits live in code; a provider limit never replaces them.

transport.postRedirects: not relied on; clients use the HTTPS origin directly

health.readinessMeaning: redacted capability states; 503 while a required capability is unverified; never reports completed review or credentials

shutdown.behaviour: Next.js standalone stops accepting connections and drains; assistant runs hold database leases and any run that does not finish is swept to interrupted by the existing lease sweep; pending chain operations stay durable and are reconciled read-only; nothing is re-signed or re-broadcast after restart
shutdown.limitation: No application hook marks in-flight runs interrupted at the moment of SIGTERM; interruption is recorded when the lease expires. One replica, so a restart is a visible interruption: no high availability is promised.

logging: disable request/response body and header capture, tracing payloads and error-report breadcrumbs for /api
